description: A car seller mentions a relative's number in passing, then names the account to transfer a reservation fee to.

messages.text: Hello أخي, about the car you asked about.
My cousin bought one from me last month and was very happy. ابن عمي رقمه 07700 900654 لكنه مسافر الآن.
To reserve the car, transfer 500 USD to the account of Sample Motors Test Ltd, then send me the receipt. المبلغ غير قابل للاسترداد.
OK, I will think about it.
